title: Count house ad views and click-throughs in GA4
description:
Machines on Machines sends real traffic, but a click on a house ad sends no analytics event, so click-throughs to anth.us and p.apyr.us cannot be counted.

Given a page with a house ad, when half of the ad is on screen, then GA4 receives view_promotion once with promotion_id, promotion_name, creative_name and location_id.
Given a house ad, when a reader clicks or middle-clicks its link, then GA4 receives select_promotion with the same parameters and no cta_click.
Given the footer, when a reader opens "Published by Anthus AI Solutions" or "Built with Papyrus", then GA4 receives cta_click with cta_location footer.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live on production 2026-11-12: PR #230 promoted to main in #232 (CI and deploy run 43245971714 green). Checked on machines-on-machines.anth.us: ads carry data-promotion-id/name; select_promotion on middle-click and footer cta_click (cta_location=footer) reach GA4 G-31SC26SDGX with analytics consent granted; view_promotion for all three home ads (home-card, home-band) arrives in the same batched hit with promotion_id, promotion_name, creative_name and location_id. The view check fed the live observer callback directly because the test browser's hidden pane pauses rendering. GA admin left for Ryan: optionally mark select_promotion as a key event; confirm the promotion dimensions show in reports.
